purpose: Select a license-clear modern constrained benchmark and external baseline set, and authorize preparation of a versioned plan amendment plus additive specifications and expected-red tests only. This candidate does not freeze an experiment matrix, install or download dependencies, change production code, call an evaluator, run an optimizer or consume formal FFE.

decision_B_modern_benchmark.meaning: Use the BSD-3-Clause coco-experiment 2.8.2 implementation of COCO bbob-constrained as the proposed modern primary suite in a new, separately declared analysis family.
required_pre_execution_contracts: Bind the package artifact, version and environment before the first evaluator call.
Freeze dimensions, instances, seeds, budget, stopping, restart and inferential-unit policies.
Freeze whether and how the COCO-provided feasible initial solution is inserted identically for applicable stochastic algorithms.
Retain all m=1 functions as prespecified fallback controls and declare m>=3 as the CVGR mechanism applicability domain.
Keep COCO, CEC2006 and any CEC2020-M4 supplement as separate benchmark and analysis families.

decision_D_constrained_de_peer.meaning: Select LSHADE44-IEpsilon as the proposed same-family constrained-DE peer, prepared from the primary-paper algorithm contract without copying unlicensed third-party source.
required_pre_execution_contracts: Prepare a versioned mathematical and algorithmic identity specification.
Prepare deterministic fixtures and expected-red tests for population schedule, mutation strategies, parameter adaptation, epsilon schedule, constraint ordering, archive and exact FFE accounting.
Keep implementation and green tests behind a later hash-bound authorization.

decision_X_cross_family_stochastic.meaning: Select pycma 4.4.4 ConstrainedFitnessAL as the proposed license-clear cross-family stochastic robustness control.
required_pre_execution_contracts: Freeze equality-to-inequality conversion and equality tolerance.
Disable or ledger any recommendation, feasibility or update evaluation outside the paired oracle.
Use a memoized paired objective-plus-full-constraint evaluator and assert exact call counts.

decision_L_local_control.meaning: Select SciPy 1.18.0 COBYLA as a non-headline deterministic local calibration control, not as the strong stochastic global baseline.
required_pre_execution_contracts: Freeze start-point policy, bounds conversion, constraint sign, equality handling, tolerances and termination.
Memoize repeated objective and constraint callbacks at the same x.
Reconcile SciPy maxiter semantics with the project paired-FFE ledger.

decision_A_amendment_scope.meaning: Prepare a versioned additive amendment that proposes the selected benchmark and baseline matrix. The historical frozen plan remains immutable, and the amendment remains non-effective until a later hash-bound freeze authorization.

required_red_coverage: COCO problem identity, dimension, instance and per-constraint-vector exposure
paired objective-plus-full-constraint cache with objective_calls == constraint_calls == project formal FFE
no hidden target, recommendation, feasibility or terminal evaluation
pycma equality, best-update and paired-FFE semantics
SciPy COBYLA callback caching and termination accounting
common bounds, residual sign/order, equality tolerance, seed and output-schema contracts
decision_T_tdd_scope.phase_boundary: Preparation and expected-red/static execution become allowed only after exact author confirmation of this candidate. Dependency installation, production implementation and green execution require later hash-bound authorization.

supplement_boundary.meaning: Do not promote CEC2020-M4 or ENOPPY to the primary modern suite, do not infer 57-problem identity from the existing limited cross-check, and do not execute the supplement without separate authorization.

authorization_effect_if_confirmed: Record the selected modern benchmark and external baseline decisions.
Prepare a versioned additive modern-matrix amendment without freezing it.
Prepare additive specifications, deterministic fixtures and expected-red/static tests for benchmark identity, baseline identity, common semantics and exact paired-FFE accounting.
Run only the newly authorized expected-red/static tests with all evaluator access forbidden and formal FFE fixed at zero.
Prepare a separate hash-bound freeze or production-implementation candidate for later author confirmation.
not_authorized_even_if_confirmed: Editing or replacing historical frozen snapshots.
Freezing the modern matrix or any pending M/H or parent-identity amendment by inference.
Installing or downloading coco-experiment, pycma, ENOPPY or any other dependency.
Copying or redistributing CEC source without a verified license.
Changing production optimizer, evaluator, adapter or benchmark code.
Calling an objective, constraint, benchmark, optimizer or evaluator.
Executing Stage 6 experiments, full TCAC, Stage B or any formal FFE.
Forming performance, superiority, novelty or paper-readiness conclusions.
Public release, remote push, submission or publication.
